description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions for a device in an OpenWRT build. It defines functions to check if a system image is suitable for upgrade and to perform the upgrade, with behavior specific to certain hardware models.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the current device's board supports upgrading the image. Returns success for specific board models, otherwise indicates unsupported.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process for supported boards, calling the default upgrade function for specific models and setting partition name.
